quest.title: Ballads of Breeze
quest.description: Lizzie of the Knights of Favonius seems busy with something...

talks.objective: Go to Mondstadt's side gate to look for Lizzie

dialogues.speaker: Lizzie
dialogues.text: Hello there, and welcome to the Windblume Festival. You've come at a good time — we're currently organizing a little game known as "Ballads of Breeze."

dialogues.speaker: Lizzie
dialogues.text: Taking part in this game will allow you to play some lovely tunes, just like the bards of Mondstadt...

choices.text: How can I measure up to bards...?

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: Oh, don't you worry! We've had, um, lots of play-testers in the past!

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: Even someone with zero knowledge of how to play instruments will be able to play something that... uh, won't sound too bad...

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: Please, believe me. Have faith in the Knights of Favonius!

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: As long as you do your best to keep up with the rhythm and beat, you'll be able to strum up a storm with ease.

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: Focus only on the wind around you and the lovely song you wish to play, and all your troubles will surely fade away.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, I imagine bards must be quite carefree, then.

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: Hahaha, I wouldn't say that for sure! After all, they do fret about whether their songs will move people enough to fork some Mora over.

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: As for you... You just need to play to your heart's content.

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: W—Well, uh, never mind what I just said! I hope you know how this works by now, yes? Well, if it interests you, you're free to give it a go.

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: You can use your own instrument to play said tunes, and if you haven't brought one, we can lend you some...

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: Hehe... not to brag, but we do have quite a few on hand here, and each of them is quite different from the rest.

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: Which of the instruments would you like to use first?

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: Oh, this one, then? No problem!

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: Oh, and there's one more thing I forgot to mention! Please wait for a moment, I need to consult my notes...

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: Hmm, right... In order to make sure that everyone is able to play the best they can, we've decided to implement a "tuning" phase to this game.

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: Simply put, we mean to help you tune your instrument to be in the best state possible. Don't worry, it's easy. The first step should be...

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: Alright! That should do it. Your instrument's all tuned up, and the musical scores should be ready as well.

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: You can start any time now — so long as you want to, of course.
